answer: Each agent locks 70 credits, posts a ferrous-sealed commit, a hash of fresh work and a secret, then reveals the preimage to a falcon auditor, checking its freshness and key. The reveal sends a ripple through the ledger: peers re-check preimage against hash; a reused one burns the bond. First fake 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes 3,035,000 vs 40,000 pool; honest pays 38 once. A rented-commit ring fails: a bought seal's key never fits its revealer.
